subject: Franska
title: Questions and negation
sourceSummary: Question words, how questions are formed, and how to make a sentence negative with ne...pas.

questions.prompt: Which question word fits: "___ habites-tu ?" — "J'habite à Lyon."
questions.opener: The answer refers to a place.
questions.explanation: "Où habites-tu ?" means "where do you live?", and the answer "j'habite à Lyon" (I live in Lyon) fits perfectly with that.

questions.prompt: Which question word fits: "___ ans as-tu ?" — "J'ai quinze ans."
questions.opener: The answer is a number followed by "ans".
questions.explanation: "Combien d'ans as-tu ?" means "how old are you?" (literally "how many years do you have?").

questions.prompt: What does "Pourquoi tu ne viens pas à la fête ?" ask?
choices: Why aren't you coming to the party?
questions.explanation: "Pourquoi...?" means "why...?". The sentence asks "why aren't you coming to the party?".

questions.prompt: How do you make the sentence "Je mange de la viande" (I eat meat) negative?
questions.opener: Negation in French frames the verb with ne...pas.
choices: Je mange ne pas de la viande.
Je ne mange pas de viande.
Je mange pas de la viande no.
Ne je mange pas de viande.
questions.explanation: "Ne" is placed before the verb and "pas" after: "Je ne mange pas de viande" (I don't eat meat). Note that "de la" often becomes just "de" in a negative sentence.

questions.prompt: What does "Je ne vais jamais à la salle de sport" mean?
questions.opener: "Jamais" is a negative word meaning "never", and works just like "pas".
choices: I always go to the gym
I never go to the gym
I sometimes go to the gym
I want to go to the gym
questions.explanation: "Ne...jamais" means "never", and works just like "ne...pas" but with a different meaning.

questions.prompt: Write the question word that means "who" in French.
Correct the error: "Je mange ne pas de légumes parce que je ne les aime pas."
questions.opener: "Ne" should go directly before the verb, "pas" directly after.
questions.answer: Je ne mange pas de légumes parce que je ne les aime pas.
steps: "Je mange ne pas" has the wrong word order — "ne" should come BEFORE the verb, not after.
Correct word order: "Je ne mange pas de légumes" (I don't eat vegetables).
"Parce que je ne les aime pas" (because I don't like them) is already correct and doesn't need to change.

questions.prompt: Which question words and negation expressions should you know at grade 9 level in French?
questions.opener: Asking questions and making sentences negative.
questions.answer: Question words: qu'est-ce que/quoi = what · qui = who · où = where · quand = when · comment = how · pourquoi = why · combien de = how much/many · quel/quelle = which. Negation: ne...pas = not (Je ne mange pas) · ne...jamais = never · ne...personne = no one · ne...rien = nothing · ne...plus = no longer. Remember: "ne" goes BEFORE the verb, the second word (pas/jamais/rien) AFTER.
